### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Verify process identity (cmdline marker match, fail-closed) before signaling or classifying liveness of any pid read from a recorded source — pidfile, activity ledger, saved state — because the OS recycles pids and a stale record can point at an innocent process. Use when implementing or reviewing stop/cleanup/reap/monitor paths that act on a stored pid.
